clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Lydon’s toxin is bound for Thunder Bluff, where Zamah awaits it. She needs the formula to make a device that can spread it against the Venture Company.

Apothecary Lydon has made the toxin from the ingredients gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He wants to see it tested on living subjects, but the liquid needs a way to spread it. You carry the vial across the Great Sea to Mulgore, where Apothecary Zamah waits for it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the toxin. If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results. I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!
But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah. She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have returned, friend. Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A toxin from Apothecary Lydon? Very good. If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...
